method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: AI anxiety sparks tech rout, broad selloff in Asian markets
Equities.reason: Clear market-wide narrative: AI 'fatigue'/skepticism is driving a broad tech and semiconductor selloff across Asia. This is a high-relevance, negative signal for equities (particularly growth/AI-led tech), implying weaker risk appetite and potential spillover to global indices.

Equities.title: Korean Markets Hit by Turmoil as Chip Rout Forces Trading Halts
Equities.reason: Localized market dysfunction (trading halts) tied to the chip selloff signals elevated market stress and liquidity risk. Strong negative implication for regional and tech-weighted global equities; high relevance due to potential contagion and volatility.

Equities.title: Chip Rout Deepens on Circular Funding, China Competition Fears
Equities.reason: Fundamental negative drivers for semiconductor sector (funding/circular financing concerns and China competition) reinforce the dominant negative equity narrative; important for tech earnings and sector leadership risk.

Equities.title: Nasdaq futures fall after Asia chip stock sell-off; investors await earnings blitz: Live updates
Equities.reason: Immediate transmission of Asian chip weakness into U.S. futures highlights cross-market contagion into U.S. tech risk premia ahead of major earnings — a near-term bearish signal for equity market openings.

Equities.title: SK Hynix shares plunge nearly 15% in Seoul as chip sell-off deepens
Equities.summary: South Korean semiconductor shares tumbled on Tuesday, extending a rout in chipmakers after another weak session on Wall Street.
Equities.reason: Major-cap semiconductor stock suffering a sharp, idiosyncratic move that underscores sector-wide derating. Relevant as a bellwether for memory/capex-sensitive names but lower relevance than broader macro pieces.

Equities.title: AI stock sell-off deepens as investors dump chipmakers
Equities.summary: South Korea’s tech-heavy Kospi leads declines in Asia
Equities.reason: High-quality confirmation of the dominant theme: investor reappraisal of AI upside leading to concentrated selling in chip/AI supply-chain names. Reinforces bearish equity regime for growth/AI exposure.

Equities.title: Nvidia and OpenAI in talks for up to $250 billion backstop to fund AI infrastructure plans
Equities.summary: The backstop would let OpenAI raise debt for a data center campus in Pike County, Ohio, on the strength of Nvidia's credit.
Equities.reason: Company-level support that could shore up Nvidia/OpenAI financing and underpin parts of the AI infrastructure thesis. Positive for select mega-cap tech/AI names but lower relevance versus the systemic selloff theme.

Equities.title: Nvidia behind $50bn lease on Texas data centre that will use its chips
Equities.summary: CEO Jensen Huang deploys balance sheet to backstop growth of AI computing market
Equities.reason: Strategic, high-profile capex/leasing activity by Nvidia supports the longer-term AI leadership narrative; however, market-moving relevance is muted relative to the broader negative risk-off in tech.

Equities.title: Apple reclaims title of world’s largest company after historic stretch of outperformance
Equities.reason: Mega-cap concentration in indices: Apple regaining top market cap is a positive for large-cap benchmarks and highlights dispersion within tech. Relevant as a moderating force on broad index moves, but lower overall relevance vs sector-wide selloff.

Equities.title: JPMorgan Sees S&P 500 Poised to Rally as New Buy Signal Flashes
Equities.reason: A tactical/technical buy signal from a major bank offers a possible near-term bullish counterpoint for broad equities. Treated as lower-relevance given stronger fundamental/sector selloff drivers currently dominating market action.

Rates.title: RBA’s Bullock Says Economy Cooling, Unsure Rates High Enough
Rates.reason: Governor Bullock's comments (economy cooling but unsure if rates are high enough) leave the door open for further tightening or a higher-for-longer path — bearish for bond prices (yields likely to stay elevated).

Rates.title: Azimut Fund Manager Bets on Japanese Bonds as Yields Surge
Rates.reason: Headline explicitly references a surge in yields in the JGB market; while investors may buy the dip, the dominant signal is higher yields / bond selloff which is negative for rates (bond prices down).

Rates.title: ECB to start implementing enhanced repo facility for central banks
Rates.reason: An enhanced repo facility is a liquidity backstop for central banks/markets; this should ease term premium and market functioning, modestly supportive for bond prices (yields a touch lower).

Rates.title: Monetary policy decisions
Rates.reason: ECB's July policy decisions and accompanying tone are part of the prevailing restrictive/higher-for-longer macro regime in rates; that stance is negative for bond prices (yields supported higher).

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Close July call keeps Dollar traders data-focused – BNY
Rates.summary: BNY strategists John Velis and David Tam expect the Federal Reserve (Fed) to keep the federal funds rate unchanged at the upcoming July Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, while stressing it is a close call.
Rates.reason: A close Fed decision that keeps rates unchanged (but is a close call) implies elevated policy rates and sticky higher-for-longer expectations — mildly negative for bond prices (yields supported).

Rates.title: Mounting US Budget Deficit Complicates Fed’s Interest Rate Choices
Rates.reason: Rising US budget deficits increase supply and inflation/term-premium risks and complicate the Fed's trade-offs — tends to push yields higher (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Japan's Katayama: Need to communicate JGB market before budget compilation
Rates.summary: In the Asian trading session on Tuesday, Japan Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama highlighted the need to communicate to financial and Japanese Government Bonds (JGBs) markets regarding the administration’s intentions towards the fiscal policy stance.
Rates.reason: Official emphasis on communicating with the JGB market ahead of budget signals potential fiscal-driven market impact and supply/volatility risk for JGBs — modestly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises: lending conditions tightened
Rates.reason: The survey's finding that lending conditions have tightened is consistent with restrictive monetary policy transmission — a modest negative for bond prices as policy rates remain elevated.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Trades vulnerably near 1.3300 ahead of Fed-BoE policy
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) trades with caution at around 1.3300 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Major G10 pair showing GBP vulnerability into a Fed/BoE policy window; aligns with USD-firm narrative ahead of the FOMC and is market-relevant for FX flows.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index remains subdued near 101.50 amid Fed policy uncertainty
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground after three days of gains and trading around 101.50 during the Asian session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY read showing short-term USD weakness; counters the dominant USD-into-FOMC theme so given lower relevance as a counter-signal.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar struggles near two-week low vs USD amid bearish oil prices, ahead of FOMC
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair enters a bullish consolidation phase near a two-week high, touched during the Asian session on Tuesday, and currently trades around 1.4120.
FX.reason: USD/ CAD strength reflects USD firmness ahead of FOMC and commodity-linked weakness in CAD; relevant for USD-centric FX flows and oil transmission to CAD.

FX.title: US Dollar: Stronger into FOMC on hawkish expectations – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes the US Dollar (USD) has reversed early-week losses and is trading near year-to-date highs ahead of tomorrow’s Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting.
FX.reason: Pro bank/research call explicitly linking USD strength to hawkish FOMC expectations; high relevance and reinforces the dominant USD-strength narrative.

FX.title: Euro revisits monthly low against US Dollar in countdown to Fed’s policy
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) falls to its monthly low at around 1.1362 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Tuesday. The major currency pair weakens as the US Dollar extends gains amid caution ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary
FX.reason: EUR hitting monthly lows versus USD is a clear manifestation of USD strength into the Fed event; significant for G10 FX regime and market risk pricing.

FX.title: Indian Rupee rallies futher as falling oil prices reduce foreign reserve concerns
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its winning streak against the US Dollar (USD) for the third trading day on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair falls to near 95.65 as a further decline in oil prices has strengthened the Indian currency.
FX.reason: INR strength is driven by falling oil (positive for India), representing an FX flow driver versus USD but is a localized, commodity-transmission story with moderate relevance to the USD narrative.

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens on easing safe-haven demand, US tariffs
FX.summary: USD/CHF continues its winning streak for the seventh successive day, trading around 0.8190 during the European hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: CHF weakening vs USD (USD/CHF rising) signals reduced safe-haven flows and supports USD strength narrative; direct USD pair relevance for G10 FX.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Slides to 0.6970 after failing to clear 38.2% Fibo. hurdle
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair attracts some follow-through selling following the previous day's failure to find acceptance above the 0.7000 psychological mark and weakens to the 0.6970 area during the Asian session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: AUD weakness versus USD (failure to hold 0.7000) reinforces the broader USD-firm posture into the Fed; relevant for commodity-linked FX but primarily a USD-pair read.

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar shows resilience ahead of Fed meeting
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, July 28:
FX.reason: Market roundup explicitly framing USD resilience into the FOMC; high relevance as a synthesis piece that reinforces the dominant USD-driven market regime.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar struggles above mid-0.5700s as USD stays firm ahead of FOMC meeting
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair turns lower for the second consecutive day following a modest Asian session uptick to the 0.5785 region on Tuesday.
FX.reason: NZD weakness framed explicitly as USD firmness ahead of the FOMC; relevant as another G10 example of USD-led pressure but smaller market footprint than majors.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah drops as Bank Indonesia shakeup
FX.summary: USD/IDR extends gains for the second successive day, trading around 18,130 during the early European hours on Tuesday. The currency pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces pressure following the surprise resignation of Bank Indonesia (BI) Governo
FX.reason: Central-bank shock (surprise BI governor resignation) is a material local FX driver causing IDR weakness vs USD; high relevance for EMFX and risk sentiment implications.

FX.title: Polish Zloty: Political fragmentation clouds zloty outlook – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose highlights that Poland’s Law and Justice party has split, with Mateusz Morawiecki forming Development Plus and polling above the Sejm threshold.
FX.reason: Political fragmentation poses localized downside risk for PLN vs EUR/USD/CHF funding flows; relevant as an EM/CE regional FX political driver but not central to G10/USD regime.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil flirts with the $80 level amid speculation about US-Iran peace talks
Commodities.summary: Oil prices remain depressed on Tuesday, as hopes of a new round of peace talks between the US and Iran boosted hopes of a de-escalation of the Middle East conflict.
Commodities.reason: FXStreet note ties lower WTI to rising de‑escalation hopes. Reduced geopolitical risk lowers the Middle East risk premium and directly weighs on physical crude prices — clear bearish signal for oil with market-relevant implication for benchmarks.

Commodities.title: Brent: Price slide reflects de-escalation hopes – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank strategist Charlie Lay, notes Brent Oil tumbled 8.7% to USD 88.36, reversing much of last week’s surge as US–Iran tensions eased and markets priced in de-escalation.
Commodities.reason: Large intraday Brent move (-8.7%) attributed to easing US–Iran tensions. This is a high‑signal, market-moving price move that materially reduces the geopolitical premium in global oil markets — strongly bearish for crude.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: EIA stock build is a direct supply-side datapoint. Higher commercial crude inventories versus the prior week is bearish for near-term oil prices and reinforces the downwards pressure from reduced geopolitical risk.

Commodities.title: Oil prices fall 1% as investors weigh pause in US strikes on Iran
Commodities.reason: Reuters lines up market reaction to a pause in US strikes — a clear de‑risking event. Broad newswire confirmation of falling prices tied to geopolitical pause adds meaningful market relevance for crude.

Commodities.title: WTI consolidates near one-week low, around $81.00 as traders eye US–Iran talks
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – is seen consolidating the previous day's heavy losses and trading around the $81.00 mark, just above a one-week high set during the Asian session on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: WTI consolidating near a one-week low after heavy losses tied to US–Iran developments. Reinforces the prevailing bearish oil regime driven by de‑escalation and risk premium compression.

Commodities.title: Energia Costa Azul, Mexico's second LNG terminal, shipped first cargo
Commodities.summary: Energia Costa Azul, the second liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in Mexico, shipped its initial cargo from Phase 1 of the terminal on July 8, according to the project developer. The completion of the project adds 0.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d
Commodities.reason: New LNG export capacity (0.4 Bcf/d) increases global liquefaction supply and export flows. Adds incremental supply to the LNG market — a modest bearish fundamental for natural gas/LNG prices.

Commodities.title: TotalEnergies benefits from EU sanctions reprieve on Russian gas
Commodities.summary: French energy major can continue selling LNG from its Yamal project in Siberia to Asian customers
Commodities.reason: EU sanctions reprieve allowing continued LNG sales from Yamal supports additional supply into global markets (notably to Asia). That supply tailwind is a bearish factor for regional gas/LNG prices and energy availability narratives.

Commodities.title: Gold: Supported by lower oil prices and yields – ING
Commodities.summary: ING’s Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey report that Gold has moved higher on Monday as falling Oil prices ease inflation concerns and weigh on the US Dollar (USD) and Treasury yields.
Commodities.reason: ING links lower oil and yields to stronger gold via lower inflation expectations and softer USD/yields — a plausible short-term supportive channel for bullion. Moderate relevance since it's an analyst note rather than broad price move.

Commodities.title: Gold languishes below $4,050; eyes further losses as focus remains on FOMC decision
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone through the first half of the European session on Tuesday and currently trades just below $4,050, down nearly 0.80% for the day.
Commodities.reason: FXStreet price call showing intraday weakness in gold tied to USD strength and FOMC focus. Market-moving for bullion on a short-term basis — bearish signal that offsets some analyst support pieces.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $57.50 despite easing Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) declines after registering nearly 0.5% gains in the previous day, trading around $57.50 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Silver trading softer intraday; similar drivers to gold (USD/FOMC, risk appetite) but typically lower liquidity and higher beta to industrial demand — modest bearish near-term price signal.

Commodities.title: Oman presents Hormuz fee proposal to Iran
Commodities.summary: According to a Gulf source, Oman presented a proposal for a joint regional mechanism to Iran to manage the Strait of Hormuz, a vital passage for almost 20% of the global energy supply, with voluntary fees, Reuters report.
Commodities.reason: Proposal for a regional mechanism to manage the Strait of Hormuz implies reduced transit risk and potentially lower shipping premium for oil. It's a structural development that mildly reduces tail risk for crude flows — modestly bearish.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs post third straight weekly inflows despite $465 million in late-week losses
Crypto.reason: Sustained ETF inflows are a clear adoption/liquidity positive for Bitcoin, supporting price discovery and on‑ramp demand — a material, market‑level bullish signal for crypto.

Crypto.title: Thailand's SEC alleges Bitkub concealed cyberattack that led to $50 million hack
Crypto.reason: Allegations that a major exchange concealed a hack directly hit market trust and counterparty risk — a significant negative for crypto sentiment and exchange-native asset flows.

Crypto.title: Lido begins moving $16.5 billion in staked ether to cut validator count by a third
Crypto.reason: Large-scale rebalancing of $16.5bn in staked ETH is a meaningful protocol/liquid‑staking event with implications for ETH supply dynamics, staking derivatives and market positioning.

Crypto.title: Circle buys nearly 1,000 blockchain patents from IBM
Crypto.reason: Acquisition of extensive blockchain IP by a major stablecoin issuer signals institutional tech buildout and long‑term investment in crypto infrastructure — adoption/strengthening positive.

Crypto.title: Securitize builds Wall Street credentials with SEC adviser license as tokenization expands
Crypto.reason: Regulatory credentialing for a tokenization platform increases the path for institutional issuance and custody of tokenized assets — supportive for long‑term adoption trends.

Crypto.title: U.S. Senate puts off crypto Clarity Act for now as it focuses limited bandwidth elsewhere
Crypto.reason: Delay of a major legislative clarity effort prolongs regulatory uncertainty in the US — a net negative for institutional participation and policy‑driven flows.

Crypto.title: Kalshi, Polymarket win pause against Minnesota's prediction market ban
Crypto.reason: Court pauses on state-level bans are modestly positive for regulated prediction markets and related crypto-enabled platforms, preserving product access and legal precedent.

Crypto.title: Cloud data firm Storj files for Chapter 11, extending a week of crypto failures. Token slides 16%
Crypto.reason: A token‑linked corporate bankruptcy and a sharp token drop reinforce idiosyncratic credit/failure risks in the sector — negative for risk appetite within crypto.

Crypto.title: Digital asset trading platform Uphold cuts 17% of global headcount as crypto winter bites
Crypto.reason: Material layoffs at a trading platform are a signal of cost‑cutting and weaker revenue environment across crypto firms — a negative for industry health and staffing‑driven capacity.

Crypto.title: Interest rates in U.S., U.K., Japan and Coinbase, Strategy earnings: Crypto Week Ahead
Crypto.reason: Macro rate policy and upcoming central‑bank decisions are a dominant cross‑asset driver; a higher‑for‑longer rates backdrop risks weighing on crypto risk assets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin shrugs off AI selloff but high-stakes Fed meeting could determine what's next
Crypto.reason: Bitcoin resilience amid an AI‑led equity selloff points to continued demand, but Fed policy remains the dominant macro risk that could flip sentiment quickly.

Crypto.title: Crypto steadies as Iran-U.S. pause sends oil tumbling, lifts risk assets
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical de‑escalation driving a risk‑on move in oil and broader assets is a positive transmission for crypto risk assets in the short term.

Crypto.title: Bitmine buys more ether as Tom Lee says rising ETH/BTC ratio points to stronger crypto prices
Crypto.reason: Notable institutional/firm accumulation of ETH and commentary on ETH/BTC ratio provide a modest supportive signal for broader crypto price momentum.

Crypto.title: What are perps, anyway? Everything you need to know about crypto’s hottest trading instrument
Crypto.reason: Educational piece on perpetual futures is low‑signal for directional markets but relevant for understanding leverage and liquidity mechanics in crypto trading.

Crypto.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy boosted cash reserve to $3.75 billion, repurchased $25 million of STRC
Crypto.reason: Treasury/capital moves and buybacks by a prominent crypto investor are modestly supportive signals but idiosyncratic in scope.
